notes: MXB Race Day Live v0.5.5: replaces the substitute Garage viewer with a live mirror of the actual MX Bikes Bike Selection renderer using Windows DWM, while keeping the source simulator window behind Race Day Live and out of the taskbar. Garage input is forwarded to the real game UI so installed bikes, riders, paints and gear are rendered by MX Bikes itself. This release also creates a dedicated MXB Race Day Live.exe launcher from the active pythonw runtime, switches to one permanent AppUserModelID, makes the desktop shortcut target that named EXE, and uses the desktop shortcut's actual Explorer-rendered icon for the running taskbar button. v0.5.4 two-way game/profile integration and stay-open hot updating are preserved.
